:::{#def-lempel-ziv-parsing}
#### Incremental parsing

Let $x = (x_1, \ldots, x_n)$ be a message of symbols.
The **incremental parsing** of $x$ cuts it into consecutive *phrases*,
reading from the left:
each phrase is the shortest string that is not an earlier phrase.

Every phrase is therefore an earlier phrase, or the empty string,
followed by one new symbol.
The last phrase may be cut short by the end of the message,
in which case it repeats an earlier phrase.

:::
